Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical genealogical error by misidentifying the paternal grandfather of Germaine of Foix. In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the paternal grandfather was "Gaston I de Foix-B arn" (the 14th-century Count). This error stemmed from a failure to correctly synthesize the lineage information retrieved in Step 2. The WebSurfer results in Step 2 explicitly stated that John of Foix (Germaine's father) was the son of "Count Gaston II of Foix" and that Gaston II was the son of "Gaston I of Foix-B arn" (d. 1343). However, the actual historical lineage for the Foix family in the 15th century (when John and Germaine lived) involves a different "Gaston I" (Gaston I, Count of Foix, d. 1436), who was the father of Gaston IV (the father of John). The Planner confused the 14th-century Gaston I with the 15th-century Gaston I, leading to a completely wrong ancestor (a man who died 100 years before Germaine's father was born). The Planner failed to verify the dates and specific titles of the "Gaston I" mentioned in the search results, instead accepting the name without checking the chronological consistency.
